_note: Evidence that the CloudFront origin is an S3 STATIC-WEBSITE endpoint, not a REST S3 origin. deploy.py must enable S3 website hosting on the dashboard bucket AND wire CloudFront to the website endpoint domain with OriginProtocolPolicy=http-only. The SPA fallback (403/404 -> index.html) is handled by the S3 website ErrorDocument, NOT by CloudFront CustomErrorResponses (which are empty on this distribution).
